messages:
Ellen V: Quick planning thread  v1->v2 deprecation for embeddings + SDK rename. Need PR owners and a tiny cheat-sheet for customers.

Ravi K: I'll write the cheat-sheet: one-page quick command, side-by-side snippet, and rollback note.

Katrina: I'll update ruby/python/js snippets. Keep both old/new examples for two releases.

Sam R: CI: I'll add `docs-snippet-smoke` GH action to run example calls against staging and assert vector lengths.

Ellen V: Rename specifics: `embed_dim` -> `vector_dim`, endpoint path `/v1/embed` -> `/v2/embeddings`. Call out new VECTOR_DIM_MISMATCH error.

Ravi K: Cheat-sheet draft will include: CLI helper (`rw migrate-embeddings --preview`), snippet diffs, and a one-liner for Dedicated customers to contact support.

Katrina: Small UX ask: unify use of `client.embeddings.create` across languages in the cheat-sheet.

docs-ci: Reminder  `docs-snippet-smoke` is required for `release:next`.

Ellen V: Timeline: PRs by Mon EOD, snippet CI green Tue AM, staging flip Wed. I'll open a PR template with checklist.

Sam R: Adding smoke tests now. Will paste outputs in this thread when green.

Ravi K: Opening cheat-sheet PR in a few mins. Please review for clarity.

Ellen V: Thanks all  we'll reconvene here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
